metadata.title: Comprehensive Puranic and Itihasic Genealogy (Vamsanucharita)
metadata.scope: Cosmic creation, Manasaputras, Svayambhuva line, 14 Manvantaras, Solar Dynasty (Surya Vamsha / Ikshvaku), Lunar Dynasty (Chandra Vamsha / Aila) and concordance across 12 scriptures.

section_1_cosmic_origin.description: Cosmic Origin from Parabrahman / Narayana to Brahma, the Manasaputras, and Svayambhuva Manu with Queen Shatarupa.

manasaputras_and_prajapatis.name: Marichi
manasaputras_and_prajapatis.prominent_descendants: Kashyapa (Prajapati), who fathered Devas, Asuras, Nagas, Manavas (through Vivasvan), Adityas

manasaputras_and_prajapatis.name: Atri
manasaputras_and_prajapatis.prominent_descendants: Dattatreya (Vishnu amsha), Durvasa (Shiva amsha), Soma/Chandra (Brahma amsha, progenitor of Chandra Vamsha)

manasaputras_and_prajapatis.name: Pulastya
manasaputras_and_prajapatis.prominent_descendants: Agastya, Vishrava (father of Kubera, Ravana, Kumbhakarna, Vibhishana)

manasaputras_and_prajapatis.name: Pulaha
manasaputras_and_prajapatis.prominent_descendants: Kardama, Sahishnu, Karmasreshtha; progenitor of various animal species/kinnaras

manasaputras_and_prajapatis.name: Kratu
manasaputras_and_prajapatis.prominent_descendants: The 60,000 Balakhilyas (thumb-sized ascetics preceding the chariot of the Sun)

manasaputras_and_prajapatis.name: Bhrigu
manasaputras_and_prajapatis.prominent_descendants: Lakshmi (Bhargavi), Dhata, Vidhata, Shukracharya (Kavya, Guru of Asuras), Chyavana, Jamadagni, Parashurama

manasaputras_and_prajapatis.name: Vashistha
manasaputras_and_prajapatis.prominent_descendants: Shakti, Parashara (father of Veda Vyasa), Vyasa (Krishna Dvaipayana), Suka

manasaputras_and_prajapatis.name: Daksha
manasaputras_and_prajapatis.consort: Prasuti (in first birth), Asikni/Panchajani (in second birth)
manasaputras_and_prajapatis.prominent_descendants: Sati (Dakshayani, consort of Shiva), Aditi, Diti, Danu, Rohini & 27 Nakshatras (consorts of Chandra)

manasaputras_and_prajapatis.name: Narada
manasaputras_and_prajapatis.prominent_descendants: Spiritual master to Valmiki, Vyasa, Dhruva, Prahlada

svayambhuva_manu_lineage.parents: Brahma split his body into Svayambhuva Manu (male half) and Shatarupa (female half)

children.name: Priyavrata
children.status: Eldest son; ruled the earth; his chariot wheels carved the 7 oceans and 7 dvipas (continents)
notable_descendants: Rishabhadeva (Avatara of Vishnu, son of Nabhi)
Bharata (eldest of 100 sons of Rishabhadeva, after whom Bharata-varsha is named)

children.name: Uttanapada
notable_descendants: Vena (corrupt king churning of whose arms produced Prithu)
Prithu (Maharaja Prithu, milker of the Earth / Prithvi)
Prachinabarhi and the Prachetas (ten brothers who performed austerities under water)

children.name: Akuti
children.status: Eldest daughter; married to Prajapati Ruchi

children.name: Devahuti
children.status: Second daughter; married to Prajapati Kardama
children.offspring: Kapila Muni (founder of Sankhya philosophy, incarnation of Vishnu) and 9 daughters married to the 9 Rishis

children.name: Prasuti
children.status: Third daughter; married to Daksha Prajapati

section_2_the_14_manus.name: Auttami (Uttama) Manu
section_2_the_14_manus.parentage: Uttanapada (brother of Dhruva / son of Priyavrata in some texts)

section_2_the_14_manus.name: Raivata Manu
section_2_the_14_manus.parentage: Brother of Tamasa Manu (line of Priyavrata)

section_2_the_14_manus.name: Chakshusha Manu
section_2_the_14_manus.avatar: Ajita (churned the Ocean of Milk as Kurma)

section_2_the_14_manus.name: Vaivasvata Manu (Shraddhadeva)
section_2_the_14_manus.scriptural_reference: Bhagavata Purana 8.13.1-4, Vishnu Purana 3.1.32-34, Matsya Purana 9.1-38

lineage_chain.name: Brahma
lineage_chain.role: Universal Creator born from the Lotus of Narayana

lineage_chain.name: Kashyapa
lineage_chain.role: Son of Marichi, married 13 daughters of Daksha; with Aditi he fathered the 12 Adityas

lineage_chain.name: Vivasvan (Surya)
lineage_chain.role: Son of Kashyapa & Aditi, the Sun Deity; married Sanjna (daughter of Vishvakarma)

lineage_chain.name: Vaivasvata Manu (Shraddhadeva / Satyavrata)
lineage_chain.role: Progenitor of humanity for current 7th Manvantara; father of Solar kings and Ila (origin of Lunar branch)

ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.name: Ikshvaku
ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.prominence: Eldest son; founder of the Solar Dynasty (Suryavamsha) in Ayodhya

ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.name: Nabhaga (Nriga)
ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.prominence: Became King Nriga (known for the chameleon curse and liberation by Krishna); renowned for charitable cattle donations

ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.name: Dhrishta
ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.prominence: Lineage produced warriors who attained Brahmana status (Dharshthas)

ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.name: Saryati
ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.prominence: Father of Sukanya (wife of Sage Chyavana) and Anarta (ruled Gujarat / Saurashtra / Anartadesha, capital Kushasthali)

ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.name: Narishyanta
ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.prominence: Founder of the Shakas / northern warrior lineages (Yama in some Puranas)

ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.name: Pramshu
ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.prominence: Progenitor of courageous monarchs, line merged into Bhalandana

ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.name: Nabhagadishta (Dista)
ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.prominence: Father of Bhalandana; ancestral to the virtuous merchant-kings like Karandhama, Avikshit, and Marutta

ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.name: Karusha
ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.prominence: Warriors known as Karushas, protectors of righteous frontiers

ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.name: Prishadhra
ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.prominence: Inadvertently killed his guru's cow in the dark, cursed to become a Shudra; attained liberation through intense forest penance

ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.name: Ila / Sudyumna
ten_children_of_vaivasvata_manu.prominence: Alternate forms due to Shiva-Parvati's forest boon/curse. As Ila, bore Pururavas to Budha (founding Lunar Dynasty); as Sudyumna, fathered Utkala, Gaya, Vinata

section_4_surya_vamsha.description: Complete chronological line of the Solar Dynasty (Ikshvaku Dynasty / Raghuvamsha) from Ikshvaku down to Sumitra.

lineage.name: Ikshvaku
lineage.epithet: First ruler of Ayodhya; son of Vaivasvata Manu
lineage.notes: Had 100 sons; Vikukshi, Nimi, and Dandaka prominent

lineage.name: Vikukshi (Shashada)
lineage.epithet: Hare-eater (ate a hare during Shraddha preparation)
lineage.notes: Succeeded Ikshvaku at Ayodhya

lineage.name: Puranjaya (Kakutstha)
lineage.epithet: Hump-rider (fought Asuras while seated on Indra who took the form of a Bull/Kakud)
lineage.notes: Origin of the dynastic name Kakutsthas

lineage.name: Anenas (Anaranya I)
lineage.notes: Expanded the borders of Kosala

lineage.name: Prithu
lineage.epithet: Not to be confused with Prithu Vainya
lineage.notes: Great benefactor of sacrifices

lineage.name: Shravasta
lineage.epithet: Founder of the sacred city Shravasti
lineage.notes: Vayu and Matsya cite the founding of Shravasti

lineage.name: Brihadashva
lineage.notes: Commissioned Sage Uttanka to vanquish Dhundhu

lineage.name: Kuvalayashva (Dhundhumara)
lineage.epithet: Slayer of the subterranean demon Dhundhu
lineage.notes: Slew Dhundhu with his 21,000 sons

lineage.name: Dridhashva
lineage.notes: Preserved the royal seed

lineage.name: Prasenajit
lineage.epithet: Father of Renuka (Jamadagni's wife / Parashurama's mother)

lineage.name: Yuvanashva II
lineage.epithet: Drank consecrated water meant for his queen by mistake
lineage.notes: Gave birth to Mandhatri from his right flank through divine surgery

lineage.name: Mandhatri (Mandhata)
lineage.epithet: Universal Emperor (Chakravartin) nursed by Indra (Mam Dhasyati)
lineage.notes: Ruled all the land from where the sun rises to where it sets; married Bindumati

lineage.name: Ambarisha / Purukutsa / Muchukunda
lineage.epithet: Mandhatri had 3 famous sons: Purukutsa, Muchukunda, Ambarisha
lineage.notes: Purukutsa married the river goddess Narmada

lineage.name: Trasadasyu
lineage.notes: Born to Purukutsa & Narmada

lineage.name: Anaranya II
lineage.epithet: Slain by Ravana; cursed Ravana that he would die by a scion of Ikshvaku
lineage.notes: Direct prophecy recorded in Valmiki Ramayana Yuddhakanda

lineage.name: Trayyaruna
lineage.notes: Exiled his son Satyavrata for indiscipline

lineage.name: Satyavrata (Trishanku)
lineage.epithet: Elevated toward heaven in physical form by Sage Vishvamitra
lineage.notes: Created the southern constellations / Trishanku Svarga

lineage.name: Harishchandra
lineage.notes: Gave up his kingdom, queen Taramati, and son Rohitashva to Sage Vishvamitra to uphold truth

lineage.name: Rohita (Rohitashva)
lineage.notes: Escaped the Varuna sacrifice by substituting Shunahshepa

lineage.name: Bahu (Bahuka / Asita)
lineage.epithet: Ousted by Haihayas and Talajanghas, took refuge in Sage Aurva's ashram
lineage.notes: Died in exile while queen was pregnant with poison (Gara)

lineage.name: Sagara
lineage.notes: Conquered all earth, subdued Sakas/Yavanas; his 60,000 sons dug the ocean (Sagara) and were burnt by Kapila Muni

lineage.name: Asamanjasa
lineage.notes: Father of the noble Anshuman

lineage.name: Anshuman
lineage.epithet: Recovered the sacrificial horse from Kapila Muni with humility
lineage.notes: Began penance to bring Ganga down

lineage.name: Dilipa I
lineage.epithet: Devoted his life to tapasya for Ganga's descent
lineage.notes: Died without completing the task

lineage.name: Bhagiratha
lineage.epithet: Brought sacred Mother Ganga down from the heavens to the Netherworld
lineage.notes: Ganga named Bhagirathi; redeemed the 60,000 ancestors

lineage.name: Ambarisha II
lineage.epithet: Supreme devotee of Narayana protected by the Sudarshana Chakra against Durvasa
lineage.notes: Celebrated Ekadashi vrati

lineage.name: Rituparna
lineage.epithet: Master of dice (Akshahridaya) and friend/employer of King Nala
lineage.notes: Exchanged chariot skills for dice mastery with Nala

lineage.name: Sudasa (Mitrasaha / Kalmashapada)
lineage.epithet: Cursed by Vashistha's son Shakti to become a man-eating Rakshasa; redeemed later
lineage.notes: Legs stained black by water, hence Kalmashapada

lineage.name: Ashmaka
lineage.epithet: Born of Madayanti through Niyoga with Sage Vashistha
lineage.notes: Saved the dynasty from extinction

lineage.name: Mulaka (Narikavacha)
lineage.epithet: The Armor of Women (hidden among women when Parashurama eradicated Kshatriyas)
lineage.notes: Continued the Solar seed

lineage.name: Khatvanga (Dilipa II)
lineage.epithet: Emperor who helped the Devas and achieved Moksha in a Muhurta (48 minutes) of pure focus on Vishnu
lineage.notes: Highly praised in Bhagavata Purana

lineage.name: Raghu
lineage.epithet: Great world conqueror (Digvijaya); dynasty became globally known as Raghuvamsha
lineage.notes: Performed the Vishvajit Yajna, gave all his wealth away

lineage.name: Aja
lineage.notes: Father of Dasharatha II

lineage.name: Dasharatha II
lineage.epithet: Maharaja of Ayodhya; father of Sri Rama; chariot ranged in ten directions
lineage.notes: Queens: Kausalya, Kaikeyi, Sumitra

lineage.name: MARYADA PURUSHOTTAMA SRI RAMA
lineage.epithet: 7th Avatara of Lord Vishnu; embodiment of Dharma
lineage.notes: Brothers: Lakshmana, Bharata, Shatrughna; Consort: Sita Devi

lineage.name: Lava and Kusha
lineage.epithet: Twin sons of Sri Rama and Sita Devi
lineage.notes: Kusha inherited Ayodhya/Kushavati (Southern Kosala); Lava ruled Shravasti (Northern Kosala)

lineage.name: Atithi
lineage.epithet: Son of Kusha; celebrated host to sages and guests
lineage.notes: Detailed in Kalidasa's Raghuvamsha Canto 17

lineage.name: Nala
lineage.epithet: Not to be confused with Nala of Nishadha/Damayanti

lineage.name: Hiranyanabha (Kausalya)
lineage.epithet: Disciple of Sage Jaimini; teacher of 500 Samavedic Shakhas
lineage.notes: Great yogic scholar

lineage.name: Dhruvasandhi
lineage.epithet: Killed by a lion during a hunt

lineage.name: Sudarshana
lineage.epithet: Coronated as an infant; celebrated in Devi Bhagavata and Raghuvamsha

lineage.name: Agnivarna
lineage.epithet: Last king detailed in Kalidasa's Raghuvamsha
lineage.notes: Fell victim to excessive luxury

lineage.name: Maru
lineage.epithet: Great master of Yoga; residing at Kalapa village in Himalayas
lineage.notes: Prophesied to revive the Solar Dynasty in Satya Yuga of the next cycle (Bhagavata 9.12.6)

lineage.name: Brihadbala
lineage.epithet: King of Kosala during the Mahabharata War; fought for Duryodhana
lineage.notes: Slain on the 13th day of Kurukshetra War by Abhimanyu (Mahabharata Drona Parva)

lineage.name: Divakara
lineage.epithet: Mentioned in Bhavishya and Vishnu Puranas as reigning in Madhyadesha

lineage.name: Shakya
lineage.epithet: Scion from whom the Shakya clan of Kapilavastu branched off
lineage.notes: Connected to Gautama Buddha's ancestral lineage

lineage.name: Shuddhoda (Shuddhodana)
lineage.notes: Father of Siddhartha Gautama (Bhagavan Buddha)

lineage.name: Prasenajit (Pasenadi)
lineage.epithet: Ruler of Kosala contemporary with Buddha

lineage.name: Sumitra
lineage.epithet: LAST recorded king of the Ikshvaku Dynasty in Kali Yuga
lineage.notes: Vishnu Purana 4.22.13 states that with King Sumitra, the Solar Dynasty reaches its conclusion in Kali Yuga.

section_5_chandra_vamsha.description: Complete Lunar Dynasty (Aila Vamsha / Somavamsha) from Brahma through Atri, Chandra, Budha, Pururavas, Ayu, Nahusha, Yayati, and the five great branch houses.

origin_chain.name: Chandra (Soma)
origin_chain.notes: Born of Sage Atri and Anasuya; sovereign of the Nakshatras and medicines; eloped with Tara (wife of Brihaspati)

origin_chain.name: Budha
origin_chain.notes: Son of Chandra and Tara; planet Mercury; possessed supreme wisdom; married Ila (daughter of Vaivasvata Manu)

origin_chain.name: Pururavas (Aila)
origin_chain.notes: Son of Budha and Ila; first human monarch of Chandra Vamsha; ruled from Pratishthana (Prayag); consort was Urvashi (celestial Apsara); established the three sacrificial fires

sons_of_pururavas: Ayu (Eldest; continued the main imperial line)
Amavasu (Founded the Kanyakubja / Kanauj branch; ancestor of Sage Vishvamitra, Gadhi, and Jahnu)

descent_from_ayu_to_yayati.name: Ayu
descent_from_ayu_to_yayati.notes: Eldest son of Pururavas and Urvashi; married Prabha (daughter of Svarbhanu)

descent_from_ayu_to_yayati.name: Nahusha
descent_from_ayu_to_yayati.notes: Son of Ayu; slain the demon Hunda; temporarily crowned King of Heaven (Indra) when Indra hid; fell from grace due to insulting Sage Agastya and became a python, later redeemed by Yudhishthira (Mahabharata Vana Parva)

descent_from_ayu_to_yayati.name: Yayati
descent_from_ayu_to_yayati.notes: Son of Nahusha; celebrated Emperor who married Devayani (daughter of Shukracharya) and Sharmishtha (daughter of Danava King Vrishaparva); cursed with premature old age by Shukracharya; exchanged old age for youth with his youngest son Puru

branch_1_yadu.territory: Southwestern realms (Mathura, Saurashtra, Malwa, Narmada Valley)

key_sub_lineage.name: Yadu
key_sub_lineage.role: Eldest son; founded Yadava lineage

key_sub_lineage.name: Sahasrajit
key_sub_lineage.role: Ancestor of the Haihaya branch

key_sub_lineage.name: Mahishmat
key_sub_lineage.role: Founded Mahishmati on Narmada river

key_sub_lineage.name: Kartavirya Arjuna (Sahasrabahu Arjuna)
key_sub_lineage.role: Possessor of 1,000 arms, student of Dattatreya, captured Ravana, slain by Parashurama

key_sub_lineage.name: Kroshtu
key_sub_lineage.role: Brother of Sahasrajit; main royal line leading to Krishna

key_sub_lineage.name: Vrijinivat
key_sub_lineage.role: Successor of Kroshtu

key_sub_lineage.name: Ushangu
key_sub_lineage.role: Righteous king

key_sub_lineage.name: Chitraratha
key_sub_lineage.role: Sacrificer king

key_sub_lineage.name: Shashabindu
key_sub_lineage.role: Celebrated Chakravartin; had 100,000 sons

key_sub_lineage.name: Prithushravas
key_sub_lineage.role: Righteous monarch

key_sub_lineage.name: Vidarbha
key_sub_lineage.role: Migrated south; founded Vidarbha kingdom (Berar)

key_sub_lineage.name: Kratha
key_sub_lineage.role: Eldest son of Vidarbha

key_sub_lineage.name: Satvata
key_sub_lineage.role: Eminent patriarch; gave name to the Satvatas / Bhagavata Dharma

key_sub_lineage.name: Andhaka and Vrishni
key_sub_lineage.role: Two great sons of Satvata founding the Andhakas and Vrishnis

key_sub_lineage.name: Ahuka (from Andhaka)
key_sub_lineage.role: Father of Ugrasena and Devaka

key_sub_lineage.name: Ugrasena
key_sub_lineage.role: King of Mathura, father of Kamsa

key_sub_lineage.name: Devaka
key_sub_lineage.role: Father of Devaki (mother of Sri Krishna)

key_sub_lineage.name: Devamidhusha (from Vrishni)
key_sub_lineage.role: Grandfather of Vasudeva

key_sub_lineage.name: Shurasena
key_sub_lineage.role: Father of Vasudeva and Kunti (Pritha)

key_sub_lineage.name: Vasudeva (Anakadundubhi)
key_sub_lineage.role: Married Devaki; father of Sri Krishna and Balarama

key_sub_lineage.name: BHAGAVAN SRI KRISHNA & BALARAMA
key_sub_lineage.role: Supreme Personality of Godhead / 8th Avatara and Shesha Avatara

key_sub_lineage.name: Pradyumna
key_sub_lineage.role: Son of Sri Krishna & Rukmini (Kama Avatara)

key_sub_lineage.name: Aniruddha
key_sub_lineage.role: Son of Pradyumna, married Usha (daughter of Banasura)

key_sub_lineage.name: Vajra
key_sub_lineage.role: Sole surviving Vrishni prince after the fratricidal destruction; coronated King of Mathura / Indraprastha by Arjuna and Parikshit

branch_2_puru.dynasties: Pauravas, Bharatas, Kurus, Pandavas and Kauravas

key_sub_lineage.name: Puru
key_sub_lineage.role: Youngest son of Yayati who happily surrendered his youth to his father; inherited the central imperial throne of Pratishthana

key_sub_lineage.name: Janamejaya I
key_sub_lineage.role: Son of Puru

key_sub_lineage.name: Prachinvat
key_sub_lineage.role: Conqueror of the Eastern realms

key_sub_lineage.name: Manasyu
key_sub_lineage.role: Steadfast ruler

key_sub_lineage.name: Dushyanta
key_sub_lineage.role: Hero of Kalidasa's Shakuntala; married Shakuntala (daughter of Vishvamitra & Menaka)

key_sub_lineage.name: BHARATA (Sarvadamana)
key_sub_lineage.role: Son of Dushyanta & Shakuntala; performed 100 Ashvamedha sacrifices on Yamuna and 300 on Ganga; our subcontinent is designated 'BHARATAVARSHA' after him

key_sub_lineage.name: Bhumanyu
key_sub_lineage.role: Adopted Bharadvaja Muni's lineage blessings; son of Bharata

key_sub_lineage.name: Suhotra
key_sub_lineage.role: Great sacrificer

key_sub_lineage.name: Hastin
key_sub_lineage.role: Founded the legendary imperial capital HASTINAPURA

key_sub_lineage.name: Ajamidha
key_sub_lineage.role: Father of the Panchalas and continuing Paurava lines

key_sub_lineage.name: Riksha
key_sub_lineage.role: Righteous king

key_sub_lineage.name: Samvarana
key_sub_lineage.role: Married Tapati (daughter of the Sun God Surya)

key_sub_lineage.name: KURU
key_sub_lineage.role: Son of Samvarana & Tapati; consecrated the sacred field of KURUKSHETRA with intense tapas; founder of the Kurus

key_sub_lineage.name: Parikshit I & Jahnu & Sudhanvan
key_sub_lineage.role: Sons of Kuru; Sudhanvan line led to Brihadratha (founder of Magadha, father of Jarasandha)

key_sub_lineage.name: Pratipa
key_sub_lineage.role: Noble king, married Sunanda

key_sub_lineage.name: Devapi, Shantanu, and Bahlika
key_sub_lineage.role: Three sons of Pratipa: Devapi took to ascetic life; Bahlika ruled northwestern frontier; Shantanu took Hastinapura

key_sub_lineage.name: MAHARAJA SHANTANU
key_sub_lineage.role: Married Ganga (mother of Bhishma) and Satyavati (mother of Chitrangada & Vichitravirya)

key_sub_lineage.name: BHISHMA (Devavrata)
key_sub_lineage.role: Took terrible vow of celibacy (Bhishma Pratigya) and renounced the throne

key_sub_lineage.name: Veda Vyasa (Krishna Dvaipayana)
key_sub_lineage.role: Son of Satyavati & Sage Parashara; through Niyoga fathered Dhritarashtra, Pandu, and Vidura

key_sub_lineage.name: Dhritarashtra
key_sub_lineage.role: Blind king, married Gandhari; father of the 100 Kauravas (Duryodhana, Duhshasana, etc.)

key_sub_lineage.name: Pandu
key_sub_lineage.role: Pale king, married Kunti and Madri; father of the 5 Pandavas

key_sub_lineage.name: THE PANDAVAS
key_sub_lineage.role: Yudhishthira (Dharma), Bhima (Vayu), Arjuna (Indra), Nakula and Sahadeva (Ashvini Kumaras)

key_sub_lineage.name: Abhimanyu
key_sub_lineage.role: Son of Arjuna and Subhadra (sister of Krishna); great hero of Kurukshetra War; married Uttara

key_sub_lineage.name: PARIKSHIT II
key_sub_lineage.role: Posthumous son of Abhimanyu, rescued in the womb by Sri Krishna from Ashvatthama's Brahmashira; crowned Emperor of the World at beginning of Kali Yuga; heard the Srimad Bhagavatam from Suka Maharshi

key_sub_lineage.name: JANAMEJAYA II
key_sub_lineage.role: Son of Parikshit; performed the famous Snake Sacrifice (Sarpa Satra) to avenge his father's death by Takshaka; heard the Mahabharata recited by Vaishampayana

key_sub_lineage.name: Shatanika
key_sub_lineage.role: Son of Janamejaya II; studied under Yajnavalkya

key_sub_lineage.name: Ashvamedhadatta
key_sub_lineage.role: Son of Shatanika

key_sub_lineage.name: Nichakshu
key_sub_lineage.role: When Hastinapura was washed away by the Ganga, he shifted the capital to Kausambi

key_sub_lineage.name: Udayana
key_sub_lineage.role: Famous romantic hero of Sanskrit drama (Vatsaraja Udayana of Kausambi)

key_sub_lineage.name: Kshemaka
key_sub_lineage.role: LAST recorded king of the Puru / Bharata / Kuru dynasty in Kali Yuga (Puranic verse: 'Kshemakam prapya rajanam samstham prapsyati vai kalau')

branch_3_turvasu.dynasties: Yavanas / Cholas and Pandyas in southern Puranic traditions (Harivamsa 1.32, Matsya 48); line merged into Paurava kings through Marutta's adoption

branch_4_druhyu.dynasties: Gandharas (named after King Gandhara, brother of Dharma); Aratta; expanded into distant northern non-Vedic regions (Mlecchas)

branch_5_anu.dynasties: Anavas; lineage gave rise to King Ushinara (father of Shibi Chakravartin) and King Titikshu (father of the 5 Eastern kingdoms: Anga, Vanga, Kalinga, Pundra, and Suhma)

section_5_twelve_puranas_concordance.description: Comparative concordance and key genealogical verses across the 12 primary Puranic and Itihasic texts.

concordance_table.special_focus: The gold standard of Vamsanucharita. Precise linear succession of both Surya and Chandra Vamsha down to the future kings of Magadha, Ikshvaku, and Puru.
concordance_table.key_sanskrit_verses: Book IV, Ch 2, 4.22.13: 'इत्येते इक्ष्वाकुभूपालाः... सुमित्रं प्राप्य राजानं संस्थां प्राप्स्यति वै कलौ॥' (With King Sumitra, the Ikshvaku line culminates).

concordance_table.special_focus: Deep spiritual exposition combining exact genealogical lists with philosophical and devotional meaning (Ambarisha, Harishchandra, Sri Rama, Sri Krishna).
concordance_table.key_sanskrit_verses: SB 9.1.8-9: 'श्रीशुक उवाच: शृणु राजन् परीक्षित्... मनोर्वंशः प्रवक्ष्यते।' & SB 9.12.6: 'मरुः कलापग्रामस्थ आस्ते योगबलान्वितः... सूर्यवंशं प्रवर्त्यति।'

concordance_table.special_focus: Detailed accounts of Vaivasvata Manu, the Great Deluge, the Pitris, the Lunar branches (Yadu, Puru, Turvasu, Druhyu, Anu), and post-Mahabharata dynasties.
concordance_table.key_sanskrit_verses: Matsya Ch 11: 'मनोर्वैवस्वतस्यासीन्महान् वंशकरः सुतः। इक्ष्वाकुर्नाम धर्मात्मा...॥'

concordance_table.special_focus: One of the most archaic and historically exhaustive recensions of royal gene-trees; corroborates Vedic rishi lineages and geographical migrations.
concordance_table.key_sanskrit_verses: Vayu 88.8: 'इक्ष्वाकोस्तु शतं पुत्रा राजानः सर्व एव ते। तेषां ज्येष्ठो विकुक्षिश्च शकुनिस्तत्सुतोऽभवत्॥'

concordance_table.special_focus: Closely parallel to Vayu Purana; extensive details on Sagara, Bhagiratha, Parashurama, and Kartavirya Arjuna.
Known as the Adi Purana; detailed lists of the Solar dynasty from Ikshvaku to Rama and the Lunar dynasty through Pururavas and Yayati.
concordance_table.key_sanskrit_verses: Brahma Ch 7.1: 'ब्रह्मणा च समादिष्टो मनुः स्वायम्भुवः पुरा। प्रजारक्षणदक्षोऽसौ प्रवराणां महीक्षिताम्॥'

concordance_table.special_focus: The authoritative appendix to the Mahabharata focusing purely on the genealogy of Hari (Yadava and Paurava dynasties).
concordance_table.key_sanskrit_verses: HV 1.9.1: 'ययातेश्चरिताद् भूयः शृणु राजन् यथातथम्। पुत्राणां चैव पञ्चानां वंशाख्यानं पुरातनम्॥'

concordance_table.genealogical_location: Adi Parva (Sambhava Parva, Ch 68-95), Shanti Parva
concordance_table.special_focus: Comprehensive narration of the Lunar line from Pururavas through Shakuntala-Dushyanta, Bharata, Kuru, Shantanu, down to the Pandavas and Parikshit.
concordance_table.key_sanskrit_verses: MBh Adi 75.11: 'अत्रेः पुत्रो बभूवेन्दुः सोमस्यापि बुधः स्मृतः। पुरूरवा बुधस्यासीत् ततोऽप्यायुर्जनेश्वरः॥'

concordance_table.special_focus: The royal recitation of the Ikshvaku genealogy by Sage Vashistha at King Janaka's court for the wedding of Sri Rama and Sita.
concordance_table.key_sanskrit_verses: VR Balakanda 70.21-22: 'व्यक्ताव्यक्तभवो ब्रह्मा शाश्वतो नित्य अव्ययः। तस्मान्मरीचिः संजज्ञे मरीचेः कश्यपः सुतः॥ विवस्वान् कश्यपाज्जज्ञे मनुर्वैवस्वतः स्मृतः॥'

concordance_table.special_focus: Genealogy of Surya and Soma vamshas contextualized with Shiva worship and royal devotion.
concordance_table.key_sanskrit_verses: Linga 65.2: 'मनोर्वैवस्वतस्यासन् पुत्रा दश सुधार्मिकाः। इक्ष्वाकुप्रमुखा राजन् शृणु तेषां च संततिम्॥'

concordance_table.special_focus: Condensed summary of the royal genealogies of both Solar and Lunar branches, focusing on their sacred roots and avataric incarnations.
concordance_table.key_sanskrit_verses: Garuda 139.1: 'इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवो रामो राजीवलोचनः। तस्य वंशं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु सौनक यत्नतः॥'

concordance_table.special_focus: Exhaustive details on the 14 Manvantaras, their Manus, devas, rishis, and the early dynasties of Dishta, Karandhama, Avikshit, and Marutta.
concordance_table.key_sanskrit_verses: Markandeya 74.5: 'मन्वन्तराणि सर्वाणि व्याख्यातानि महामुने। मन्वन्तरेशपुत्राणां चरितं शृणु साम्प्रतम्॥'
